svg.title: Ethan's tech stack / 常用技术栈
svg.desc: Frontend: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Vue, Tailwind CSS, Three.js, GSAP, Electron. Backend: Python, FastAPI, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite. AI and delivery: LangGraph, Docker, Git, GitHub Actions, pytest, Vitest. Also LLM APIs, Agent, RAG, Skills, MCP and Playwright.
